figure.purpose: One real number per work chapter; unit at 0.32em in Lit Gold.

headline.purpose: Chapter H2s; light panel and Connect raise the ceiling to 6rem.

lead.purpose: Opening paragraph of a chapter in full Smoke.

label.purpose: Rail, focus areas, deliverable lines, hours, footer headings (0.78 to 0.85rem, 0.12 to 0.14em).

action.purpose: Buttons, nav and text links (0.9rem in nav).

shadows.name: copy-vignette
shadows.purpose: Background pseudo-element behind copy over the WebGL field (bottom-up linear gradient on phones).

shadows.name: header-scrim
shadows.purpose: Fixed header over the story; smoke variant over the light panel.

shadows.name: point-glow
shadows.value: radial sprite: rgba(255,240,205,1) 0, rgba(214,190,140,.9) .12, rgba(164,148,111,.25) .4, transparent 1; additive
shadows.purpose: The gold point in WebGL; scale 1.5 (2.6 at the asterisk), pulse ±8%.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve, all transitions.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Button, link, rail and underline transitions.

motion.name: stage-follow
motion.value: exponential approach, rate 5.5/s; morph smoothstep over 12%-88% of the interval with sin swirl 0.9
motion.purpose: Particle cloud and camera chasing scroll between chapter stages.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation none, transitions .01ms, WebGL time frozen

stageSystem.camera: per-chapter shot: position, target, screen-shift x/y; scaled 1.28 and centred on phones; fov 58 when aspect < 0.8
stageSystem.lines: gold LineBasicMaterial, progressive draw range (pipeline, Adelaide arcs)
stageSystem.cursor: NDC halo radius .34 pushes particles and tints gold
stageSystem.fallback: no-webgl hides the canvas; copy stays visible

narrative.overview:
One gold point moves through a deep navy field of smoke-coloured contacts and reorganises it. The whole system is built around that single act: a dark, quiet ground, thousands of small pale dots, and gold reserved for whatever PitchPoint is doing right now (the point, the line it draws, the action you can take). Type is the brand's own: DM Sans Bold in sentence case, set large and tightly tracked, over DM Sans Light body (standing in for the live site's Corp Light). It states one thing per chapter and then gets out of the way.

The page is a scroll story, not a stack of sections. A fixed full-bleed WebGL particle field sits behind everything and morphs, chapter by chapter, between built forms (scattered field, isolated silos, a dinner table for sixteen, an Asia Pacific globe, a fanned document deck, broadcast rings, a pipeline over terrain, a data hall with turbines, carbon strata, and finally the six-spoke asterisk). Copy blocks float over it on a soft navy vignette. After the story, one warm smoke "index" panel lists every service in plain columns, then a navy footer hands over the email address at display size.

Density is low and deliberate: each chapter holds a headline, one or two paragraphs and at most three service rows. Corners are square, controls are hairline-bordered, and depth comes from light (additive particles, a gold glow sprite) rather than from shadows or cards.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground, smoke text, gold only for the point, its lines and actions.
DM Sans 700 sentence-case display with tight tracking; DM Sans 300 body; small tracked uppercase labels.
Six-spoke asterisk as the only marker: list bullets, dividers, active rail state, the final 3D form.
Square corners everywhere; 1px hairline rules and borders.
A scroll-scrubbed 3D stage system with a choreographed camera per chapter.

rules.name: The Point Rule
rules.body: Gold marks where PitchPoint is acting: the glowing point, the line it draws, the asterisk, the call to action, the one emphasised phrase per headline. It never fills large areas and never becomes a background.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two surfaces: navy (the story, the footer) and smoke (the index panel). The header inverts to smoke-on-ink when it crosses the smoke panel, rather than introducing a third tone.

rules.name: The One Phrase Rule
rules.body: Each headline carries at most one Lit Gold phrase, set as non-italic `em` (font-style normal). It is the turn of the sentence, not decoration.

rules.name: The Display Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type caps at 6rem, the figure numeral at 10.5rem. Line-height for display stays under 1.

rules.name: The Light Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is made with light on navy (additive glow, distance fade, vignettes), never with drop shadows on panels.

dos: **Do** keep gold to the point, its lines, the asterisk, actions and one headline phrase (The Point Rule).
**Do** set headlines in DM Sans 700 sentence case with tight tracking; keep uppercase for small tracked labels and actions only.
**Do** use the six-spoke asterisk as the bullet, divider and active marker; draw it from the shipped SVG.
**Do** keep corners square and borders 1px; use `navy-line` on navy and `smoke-rule` on smoke.
**Do** use `gold-ink`, not `gold`, for small text on the smoke panel.
**Do** give every new chapter a 3D stage and a camera shot, with copy on the side opposite the form.
donts: **Don't** introduce rounded corners, cards or resting drop shadows on the navy story.
**Don't** add a third surface tone; navy and smoke are the only grounds.
**Don't** use more than one gold phrase in a headline, or italicise it.
**Don't** add statistics, testimonials or figures the work did not produce; the figure style is for one real number.
